description: "An Universal Dictionary of the Marine" by William Falconer is a comprehensive reference work that likely belongs to the mid-18th century. The book serves as an extensive lexicon of maritime terms and phrases, particularly focusing on the construction, equipment, and navigation of ships, along with military operations at sea.
